title: Feature/4051 sequence diagram multi directional arrow
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Added Bi-directional arrow support for dotted and solid lines in sequence diagram

Resolves #4051 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

Added new syntax ``<<->>`` for solid bidirectional arrow
Added new syntax ``<<-->>`` for dotted bidirectional arrow
Please approve new syntax.

Added unit tests for both arrows.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [X] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [X] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.

- [X] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
The startx and stopx values are calculated in the `buildMessageModel` function. 
Adding this adjustment here breaks the Separation of concern, as it makes the `drawMessage` function responsible for the adjustment, where it should only have drawn as per the dimensions calculated in `buildMessageModel`.

We should always try to solve the root cause, instead of patching the outcome.
comments.label_reasoning: The comment explicitly calls out a violation of separation of concerns — logic for calculating dimensions is being placed in a rendering/drawing function rather than in the appropriate model-building function, which is a structural/architectural issue.
